newsitem.title: USA: Citadel Computer approves stock redemption.
newsitem.headline: Citadel Computer approves stock redemption.

text.p: Citadel Computer Systems Inc said on Tuesday that its directors had authorized the company to spend up to $1.5 million to redeem all or a portion of its convertible redeemable debentures and Series B convertible preferred stock.
The company also said it had completed a private placement of $500,000 of 8 percent convertible redeemable debentures.

Under the terms of the securities, Citadel has notified holders of its interest to redeem debentures in the amount of $300,000 in principal value plus accrued interest submitted for conversion, the company said.

The company also announced that it had entered into a letter of intent with Institutional Investors Consulting Co, an investment banking group, to obtain additional debt financing to pursue the redemption program.
Citadel Computer Systems develops and markets computer software products.
